request.prompt: Premium fantasy mobile RPG skill VFX, hand-painted with luminous volumetric light, bright white-hot cores fading into rich saturated colour, fine sparks and particles, soft glow, NO outlines, NO cartoon line art. IMPORTANT: the whole image is one continuous solid pure black background; every cell sits on the same pure black, no grey, white or coloured cell backgrounds. A sprite sheet: 16 sequential animation frames of ONE effect in a 4 by 4 grid, read left to right then top to bottom, every cell exactly the same size, the effect centred in each cell with black margin all round so nothing touches a cell edge, no borders, no gaps, no numbers, no text. The effect: a ring shockwave of fire spreading across the ground, seen from directly above. Frames 1 to 3: a small bright ring of flame at the centre. Frames 4 to 10: it expands outward as a thin fiery ring throwing embers, the centre dark. Frames 11 to 16: the ring thins, breaks into sparks and fades before it reaches the cell's edge.
